meta.name: product-hunt-launch
meta.description: Product Hunt launch optimization with specific specs, timing, and gallery strategy. Covers taglines, gallery images, maker comments, and launch day tactics. Use for: product launches, startup launches, side project launches, Product Hunt optimization. Triggers: product hunt, ph launch, product hunt launch, launch strategy, product launch, startup launch, product hunt tips, product hunt gallery, ph optimization, launch day, product hunt maker

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化产品在 Product Hunt 的发布策略与效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正准备在 Product Hunt 上发布产品并希望获得更多曝光。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your Product Hunt launch strategy and results.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing to launch a product on Product Hunt and want more visibility.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你优化 Product Hunt 产品发布，包括生成标签语、设计画廊图片、撰写制作者评论，并制定发布日策略。
howto.when: 当你提到“product hunt”、“PH launch”、“发布策略”等关键词，或要求优化 Product Hunt 发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个60字符以内的Product Hunt标签语。
say.note: Claude 会按原文公式生成标签语。

say.text: 生成一张1270x760像素的产品画廊英雄图。
say.note: Claude 会调用图像生成工具。

say.text: 给我一份Product Hunt发布日的行动时间表。
say.note: Claude 会输出原文中的时间线。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps optimize your Product Hunt launch: generate taglines, design gallery images, draft maker comments, and create a launch day playbook.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "product hunt", "PH launch", "launch strategy", or ask for Product Hunt optimization.

say_en.text: Write a Product Hunt tagline under 60 characters.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the tagline formulas from the skill.

say_en.text: Generate a 1270x760 px hero gallery image.
say_en.note: Claude will call the image generation tool.

say_en.text: Give me a launch day timeline for Product Hunt.
say_en.note: Claude will output the timeline from the skill.
